TextContext.SourceString: 这里就是科摩斯内部的防御系统了吗？似乎……很危险。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is this the Comos internal defense system? Feels... dangerous.

TextContext.SourceString: 还好早有准备。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's good that we were prepared.

TextContext.SourceString: ————（断断续续）拉薇？能听到吗？拉薇？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ———— (cutting out) Lawine? Can you... hear me? Lawine?

TextContext.SourceString: 我在。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Copying.

TextContext.SourceString: 按照原计划，你已经进入了科摩斯的防御系统。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If everything has gone to plan, you should be inside the Comos defense system.

TextContext.SourceString: 亲眼见过才知道，欧泊的防御系统已经这么完善了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The power of P.U.S' defense system - you have to see it to believe it.

TextContext.SourceString: 时间紧迫，我会指引你攻破它，明和香奈美会在外围配合你。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Our time is running out. I'll guide you through. Ming and Kanami will assist from the outside.

TextContext.SourceString: 收到。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Copy that.

TextContext.SourceString: 地形检测完毕，入侵路线计算完毕。我会用预设程序在你的视网膜中模拟一个全息投影，跟紧它，机会只有一次。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We've mapped out the terrain and plotted an ingress route. The program will provide a holographic projection in your eyes. Follow the path - you've only got one shot.

TextContext.SourceString: 道路被损坏了，没办法，贴着墙走。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The path ahead is blocked. There's no choice - I'll have to wall-stick my way through.

TextContext.SourceString: 就是这样，保持住。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's it. Keep it up.

TextContext.SourceString: 这个距离无法使用常规手段突破，弦化飘飞过去吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's too far to cover on foot alone. Time to stringify and glide over there.

TextContext.SourceString: 我能感觉到，你已经开始适应这里了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I can tell that you're getting the hang of this place.

TextContext.SourceString: 报告，香奈美潜入科摩斯监控室，预计十秒后关闭警报系统，报告完毕。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Report. Kanami has made it to the Comos control room and should be disabling the alarm system within ten seconds. Over and out.

TextContext.SourceString: 梅瑞狄斯收到，拉薇，继续前进。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Copy that. Lawine, keep going.

TextContext.SourceString: 前面没有常规通路，信息库显示只有一个方案：弦化通过。
TextContext.LocalizedString: There's no conventional way forward. Our databases show that the only way to progress is through stringification.

TextContext.SourceString: 至于这里……如果我的计算没错的话，你可以借用气流飞跃过去，记得保持弦化。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As for here... If my calculations are correct, you'll be able to use the air current to give your jump an extra push! Just remember to keep stringifying!

TextContext.SourceString: 做得不错，拉薇。前方是科摩斯AI格纳库，外围所有的AI守卫都安置在这里。按照计划，明会想办法控制住全部AI守卫，你趁机摧毁它们。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Excellent work, Lawine. Ahead of you is the Comos AI Garage. All the AI perimeter guards come from here. Ming will find a way to hijack the guards - that will be your opportunity to strike.

TextContext.SourceString: 报告，明已经侵入科摩斯防御中枢，防御系统已屏蔽，预留时间三十分钟，报告完毕。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Report. Ming has struck the Comos defense center. The system should be offline for around thirty minutes. Over and out.

TextContext.SourceString: 梅瑞狄斯收到，拉薇，开始行动。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Copy that. Over to you, Lawine.

TextContext.SourceString: AI守卫不止一批，要确保百分百损毁率，继续射击。
TextContext.LocalizedString: There's more than one group of AI guards. We need to eliminate them all, so don't let up!

TextContext.SourceString: 很好，继续。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Great work. Keep going.

TextContext.SourceString: 摧毁它们，这是最后一队。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Attack! This should be the last of them.

TextContext.SourceString: 目标完全摧毁，不错。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The target has been annihilated. Not bad.

TextContext.SourceString: 不要放松警惕，这种规模的格纳库还有两个，继续前进。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stay vigilant. There will be two more garages up ahead. Let's push on.

TextContext.SourceString: 报告，AI守卫失去控制！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Report. I've lost control over the AI guards!

TextContext.SourceString: 香奈美处理不了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Kanami's been locked out!

TextContext.SourceString: 拉薇，AI恢复行动了，敌人位置不明，先确定敌方坐标。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Lawine, the guards are back online. The enemy's location is unknown. Let's start by determining the enemy's coordinates.

TextContext.SourceString: 侧面突破，当心埋伏。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We'll come through the sides. Keep your eye out for any ambushes.

TextContext.SourceString: 不行，敌人火力太过密集，紧急回避，不要恋战。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No good, enemy fire is too dense. Take evasive action, do not get bogged down.

TextContext.SourceString: 计算结果显示，正面对抗你有百分之六十以上的损毁率，更改突击方案，重新计算路线。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Calculations show that you'll have an injury chance of over 60% in a head-on confrontation. Modify the assault plan and find a new route.

TextContext.SourceString: 坐标78,312，垂直距离33，极佳的战术点。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Coordinates 78,312. Vertical distance of 33. An excellent tactical position.

TextContext.SourceString: 现在，反击。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Time to counterattack.

TextContext.SourceString: 损毁率低于预期值，很不错。科摩斯中控台就在正前方。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The amount of damage is somewhat lower than expected. Excellent! The Comos Center Console should be right in front of you.

TextContext.SourceString: 明已和香奈美会合。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ming has made successful contact with Kanami.

TextContext.SourceString: 这就开始安置炸弹。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Start planting the bomb.

TextContext.SourceString: 阿飞检测到A3点有敌人入侵，请求支援！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Enemy incursion detected at A3. Requesting support!

TextContext.SourceString: A3点？！
敌人已经穿过防御系统，来到了中控台。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The enemy has bypassed the defense system and reached the center console.

TextContext.SourceString: 月亮，被无尽的黑夜永远埋藏。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The moon had been forever buried in an endless night.

TextContext.SourceString: 漫涨的海水野蛮地吞并四方，侵蚀世间万物。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The sea beat and swelled, expanding its tendrils across the world.

TextContext.SourceString: 人们在严寒中等待救援
TextContext.LocalizedString: The wretched awaited rescue in the frozen wastes.

TextContext.SourceString: 终于发现了“卡拉彼丘”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: What they found instead was a new world - Strinova.

TextContext.SourceString: 一个以超弦形态获得永生的“理想乡”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: A “Utopia” where eternal life was possible, all thanks to the power of superstrings.

TextContext.SourceString: 在这里，没有饥饿，没有寒冷，也没有灾痛。
TextContext.LocalizedString: In Strinova, there was no hunger, no cold, and no pain.

TextContext.SourceString: 人类成为了近乎于神的存在，开启了新的纪元。
TextContext.LocalizedString: In this new era, humans became like gods.

TextContext.SourceString: 然而，无尽的生命， 究竟是人类的“梦想”还是“幻想”？
TextContext.LocalizedString: But to humanity, was eternal life more “dream” or “fantasy?”

TextContext.SourceString: 为了这一刻，我已经等待了太久。事到如今，我们无路可退。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've waited far too long for this moment. There's no turning back now.

TextContext.SourceString: 事到如今，我们无路可退
TextContext.LocalizedString: There's no turning back now.

TextContext.SourceString: 连城市都开始逆弦化，大崩溃也不远了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The city's already started to undergo reverstring, and the Big Collapse is close.

TextContext.SourceString: 大家的希望，都寄托在我们身上……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Everyone's hope rests on us...

TextContext.SourceString: 唔，时间到了，那两个人也该来了吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hm, it's time. Those two should be here by now.

TextContext.SourceString: 抱歉，我们迟到了，处理好崩溃症患者的情绪花了不少时间……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sorry we're late. It took a while to calm down the new collapse syndrome patients.

TextContext.SourceString: 处理好崩溃症患者的情绪花了不少时间
TextContext.LocalizedString: It took a while to calm down the new collapse syndrome patients.

TextContext.SourceString: 又出现了新的患者，又开始新一轮的记忆清除与重塑……
TextContext.LocalizedString: New patients again? More memory wipes and reconstructions...

TextContext.SourceString: 要我说啊，不管是崩溃还是轮回，我都不想经历。如果有一天，我也开始崩溃了……你们就直接给我个痛快！
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you ask me, I don't want to go through either collapse syndrome or restoration. If one day, I start experiencing collapse syndrome... Just put me out of my misery!

TextContext.SourceString: 如果有一天，我也开始崩溃了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: If one day, I start experiencing collapse syndrome...

TextContext.SourceString: 你们就直接给我个痛快！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just put me out of my misery!

TextContext.SourceString: 好啦，只要能提取出高纯度晶体，我们就一定可以找到返回地球的办法！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Relax, once we extract those high-purity crystals, we'll find a way back to Earth for sure!

TextContext.SourceString: 我们就一定可以找到返回地球的办法！
TextContext.LocalizedString: We'll find a way back to Earth for sure!

TextContext.SourceString: 我刚收到梅瑞狄斯的指令，科摩斯塔内，欧泊改良了晶体的提纯方式，如今即将提纯完成。希望这种纯度的晶体，可以支持我们打开空间裂隙。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I just got a message from Meredith. P.U.S has refined the purification method at Komos Tower, and they’re almost done. Hopefully, crystals of this purity will open the space rift.

TextContext.SourceString: 欧泊改良了晶体的提纯方式，如今即将提纯完成
TextContext.LocalizedString: P.U.S has refined the purification method at Komos Tower and they’re almost done

TextContext.SourceString: 希望这种纯度的晶体，可以支持我们打开空间裂隙
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hopefully, crystals of this purity will open the space rift

TextContext.SourceString: 老规矩，我来给你打掩护
TextContext.LocalizedString: As usual, I'll cover you.

TextContext.SourceString: 不，科摩斯塔内守卫森严，我们这次分开行动
TextContext.LocalizedString: No, Komos Tower is heavily guarded. This time, we'll split up.

TextContext.SourceString: 我们这次分开行动
TextContext.LocalizedString: This time, we'll split up.

TextContext.SourceString: 我来吸引欧泊的注意，你们趁机夺取晶体
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll distract P.U.S, and you take the chance to grab the crystals.

TextContext.SourceString: 收到
TextContext.LocalizedString: Got it.

TextContext.SourceString: 收到
TextContext.LocalizedString: Got it.

TextContext.SourceString: 看样子提纯快要完成了啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It looks like the purification process is almost done.

TextContext.SourceString: 心夏教官，如果这次提纯能成功的话……崩溃症是不是就有解决的可能了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Instructor Kokona, if we succeed this time, could it mean there’s hope for curing the Collapse Syndrome?

TextContext.SourceString: 崩溃症是不是就有解决的可能了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Could it mean there’s hope for curing the Collapse Syndrome?

TextContext.SourceString: 没那么简单啦，照如今崩溃症的发展进度，就算纯度真能达到预期值，也只是起到延缓的作用而已。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's not that simple. Considering the current progression of the Collapse Syndrome, even if we reach the anticipated level, it would only slow it down.

TextContext.SourceString: 就算纯度真能达到预期值，也只是起到延缓的作用而已
TextContext.LocalizedString: Even if we reach the anticipated level, it would only slow it down

TextContext.SourceString: 巴布洛晶体由叠加态转至本征态时，会因不可控的坍缩导致弦序列折损。
TextContext.LocalizedString: When the crystal transitions to an eigenstate, the collapse results in the degradation of the string sequence

TextContext.SourceString: 会因不可控的坍缩导致弦序列折损
TextContext.LocalizedString: The collapse results in the degradation of the string sequence

TextContext.SourceString: 因此，无衰减再现理论中的完美弦序列构型原本是不可能的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, achieving a perfect string sequence configuration was previously impossible

TextContext.SourceString: 无衰减再现理论中的完美弦序列构型原本是不可能的
TextContext.LocalizedString: Achieving a perfect string sequence configuration was previously impossible.

TextContext.SourceString: 但这次实验迭代了过去的提纯思路，利用黑箱法隔绝观测者以遏制坍缩。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But this experiment iterates on past purification methods. Using a black box approach to isolate the observer and prevent collapse.

TextContext.SourceString: 利用黑箱法隔绝观测者以遏制坍缩
TextContext.LocalizedString: Using a black box approach to isolate the observer and prevent collapse

TextContext.SourceString: 考虑到量子涨落在弦状网液态提纯室中的影响低于3个普朗克常数，可以认为，100%的理论纯度将成为可能。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Taking into account quantum fluctuations in the purification chamber, if they are below three Planck constants, we can consider achieving 100% theoretical purity possible.

TextContext.SourceString: 低于3个普朗克常数
TextContext.LocalizedString: If they are below three Planck constants

TextContext.SourceString: 可以认为，100%的理论纯度将成为可能
TextContext.LocalizedString: We can consider achieving 100% theoretical purity possible

TextContext.SourceString: 百分之百……那样的话，父亲岂不是……
TextContext.LocalizedString: 100%... If that's possible, my father might...

TextContext.SourceString: 菲觉得，治愈崩溃症，理论上是可行的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fay believes that, in theory, it’s possible to cure collapse syndrome.

TextContext.SourceString: 如果真的能够治愈崩溃症，父亲也许就会想起我是谁了！大家也再也不用丢失那些珍贵的回忆了……就连剪刀手，也会愿意接纳这个世界吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: If we can truly cure collapse syndrome, maybe my father could remember who I am. Nobody would have to lose their precious memories anymore... Maybe even The Scissors would come to accept this world.

TextContext.SourceString: 大家也再也不用丢失那些珍贵的回忆了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Nobody would have to lose their precious memories anymore...

TextContext.SourceString: 就连剪刀手，也会愿意接纳这个世界吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Maybe even The Scissors would come to accept this world.

TextContext.SourceString: 以和平为终点，那应该会是一个相当漫长的旅途。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If peace is our final goal, it will surely be a long journey.

TextContext.SourceString: 那应该会是一个相当漫长的旅途
TextContext.LocalizedString: It will surely be a long journey

TextContext.SourceString: 不过， 既然你都已经有了这样的觉悟，那就保持初心，直到我们解决崩溃症的那天吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But, since you already have this determination, stay true to your resolve until the day we conquer the collapse syndrome.

TextContext.SourceString: 那就保持初心，直到我们解决崩溃症的那天吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stay true to your resolve until the day we conquer the collapse syndrome.

TextContext.SourceString: 我已入侵控制中心
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've infiltrated the control center.

TextContext.SourceString: 你们按计划行事
TextContext.LocalizedString: Proceed as planned.

TextContext.SourceString: 收到
TextContext.LocalizedString: Roger that.

TextContext.SourceString: 收到
TextContext.LocalizedString: Roger that.

TextContext.SourceString: 不好，控制中心遭到入侵！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Not good, the control center's been breached.

TextContext.SourceString: 偏偏在这个时候来搞破坏……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just perfect timing for sabotage...

TextContext.SourceString: 菲也很担心，提纯只差一点点了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fay is worried. The purification process is almost complete.

TextContext.SourceString: 提纯只差一点点了
TextContext.LocalizedString: The purification process is almost complete

TextContext.SourceString: 学者的工作是专心研究，既然剪刀手想要交火——米雪儿，今天就是你的第一节实战课！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Scholars are meant to focus on their research. But since The Scissors wants a fight... Michele, today’s your first real combat lesson.

TextContext.SourceString: 米雪儿，今天就是你的第一节实战课
TextContext.LocalizedString: Michele, today’s your first real combat lesson

TextContext.SourceString: 收到！伊薇特，你安心研究，击退剪刀手的事情就交给我和心夏教官吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yvette, keep working on the research. Kokona and I will go and handle The Scissors!

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特，你安心研究，击退剪刀手的事情就交给我和心夏教官吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yvette, keep working on the research. Kokona and I will go and handle The Scissors!

TextContext.SourceString: 跟紧我，出发！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stick with me. Let's move out!

TextContext.SourceString: 注意隐蔽。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stay hidden.

TextContext.SourceString: 确认环境安全。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Confirm the area is secure.

TextContext.SourceString: 检查完毕，没有可疑人员。
TextContext.LocalizedString: All clear, no intruders.

TextContext.SourceString: 有些太过安静了，什么地方疏忽了么……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's too quiet... did we miss something?

TextContext.SourceString: 心夏教官，现在怎么办？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Instructor Kokona, what’s our next move?

TextContext.SourceString: 现在怎么办？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What’s our next move?

TextContext.SourceString: 拆弹，我掩护你。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Disarm the bomb, I’ll cover you.

TextContext.SourceString: P-4型炸弹，还记得吗？我们之前做过训练。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's a P-4 model, remember? We've trained for this.

TextContext.SourceString: 和P-4型不同，每一组的程式逻辑都不一样……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But the programming's different, each set has unique logic…

TextContext.SourceString: 程式不同？在破译难度上费尽心思，而在爆破地点却无人看守……这不像剪刀手会做的判断。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Different programming? They meticulously altered the code, yet didn’t bother guarding the bomb site... this is unlike them.

TextContext.SourceString: 在破译难度上费尽心思
TextContext.LocalizedString: They meticulously altered the code

TextContext.SourceString: 而在爆破地点却无人看守……这不像剪刀手会做的判断
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yet didn’t bother guarding the bomb site... this is unlike them.

TextContext.SourceString: 人为破坏的痕迹……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Signs of deliberate sabotage...

TextContext.SourceString: 剪刀手是故意吸引我们来拆弹的，他们在拖延时间。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Scissors are stalling us with this bomb. They're buying time…

TextContext.SourceString: 他们在拖延时间
TextContext.LocalizedString: They're buying time…

TextContext.SourceString: 爆破之外的时间……
TextContext.LocalizedString: For something beyond the explosion…

TextContext.SourceString: 糟了！你继续进行拆除作业，我去支援伊薇特！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Damn it! Keep disarming it, I’m heading to support Yvette!

TextContext.SourceString: 你继续进行拆除作业，我去支援伊薇特！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Keep disarming it, I’m heading to support Yvette!

TextContext.SourceString: 明白！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Got it!

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特，剪刀手的目的是晶体！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yvette, The Scissors' target is the crystal!

TextContext.SourceString: 伊薇特！伊薇特！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yvette! Yvette!

TextContext.SourceString: 菲，你听到了吗？四点钟方向……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fay, did you hear that? Four o'clock...

TextContext.SourceString: 正面入侵
TextContext.LocalizedString: Frontal assault

TextContext.SourceString: 侧面潜入
TextContext.LocalizedString: Infiltrating from the flank
